subject: Demo cadence & timing for OrionAI — reprioritization
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Soto <elena@orionai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo cadence & timing for OrionAI — reprioritization

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the time last week. We put together a short demo that focuses on low-latency inference patterns and cost controls for your batch scoring use case. Proposed slot: Wed Nov 3, 10:00–10:30am PT (we'll do a 25m demo + 5m Q&A).

Agenda (attached):
- 5m: goals & success criteria
- 12m: demo (dedicated vs hosted routing + caching)
- 5m: rollout/playbook (Dedicated vs Private)
- 3m: next steps & credits

If that works I'll send a calendar invite. If internal folks are traveling or priorities shifted, we can move it — happy to be flexible.

Attachments: orion-demo-agenda.pdf (PDF)

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai

From: Elena Soto <elena@orionai.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Demo cadence & timing for OrionAI — reprioritization

Priyom —

Appreciate you lining this up. Quick update from our side: leadership pulled our ML infra team onto a product launch that just moved to "all hands" for the next six weeks. That means the engineering stakeholders who would join the demo are being reallocated, and our VP is travelling through the end of November.

Given that, we need to deprioritize the inference pilot for now and pause any live demos. We still want to understand Redwood — can you send a short mutual action plan and a lightweight enablement pack we can hand to the product folks? Ideally we'll revisit in Q1 (Feb) once the launch stabilizes.

Sorry for the churn — will circle back when we have bandwidth.

Thanks,
Elena Soto
Head of Platform, OrionAI
elena@orionai.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Demo cadence & timing for OrionAI — reprioritization

Marissa / Dev —

Elena just confirmed they need to pull the pilot into the product launch for the next ~6 weeks and asked to pause demos. Not a dead stop — they want a mutual action plan + enablement material and to re-open in Feb.

My suggested next steps:
- Send a tailored enablement pack (15–20 slides + short runbook + cost/latency cheat-sheet). Include a one-page decision matrix for Dedicated vs Hosted. (I'll draft.)
- Offer a small pilot credit (1-month equivalent) and a technical office hour for their infra lead when they are back.
- Put them on our "nurture + check-in" cadence: 6 weeks, then 12 weeks, then Feb 15 check-in.
- Log this in HubSpot under DEAL-ORION-2026-04 and mark stage as "Nurture: deprioritized".

Anything you'd change? Also recommend we prepare a two-slide "migration path" focused on migrating from batch scoring on-prem -> Redwood Private for their compliance constraints.

— Priyom

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Soto <elena@orionai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo cadence & timing for OrionAI — reprioritization

Hi Elena —

Totally understand — congrats on the launch push (no small feat). We'll pause the live demo schedule and move OrionAI to our nurture track. Attached is a compact enablement pack and the agenda we had planned so your PM/infra partners can self-serve.

Proposed follow-ups from our side:
1) Enablement pack (attached) — slides + 1-page runbook + sample canary config.
2) Credit: offer a 1-month pilot credit to help them test in-sprint when ready.
3) Check-in: I'll reach out w/ a brief check-in week of Feb 14, 2027 to set a 30m tech sync.

If you'd prefer a shorter technical office hour sooner for whoever's available, we can do that asynchronously.

Attachments: redwood-enablement-pack.zip (ZIP)

Thanks again — we'll be on standby.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai

From: Elena Soto <elena@orionai.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 09:50:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Demo cadence & timing for OrionAI — reprioritization

Thanks Priyom —

Please send the enablement pack and the mutual action plan; I'll distribute to the PM and infra leads and we'll keep you posted. Appreciate the credit offer — that helps.

Elena
